messages:
chen: Heads-up — we need a small GPU node pool in europe-west4 for nightly batch fine-tuning. Current GPU quota in that region is basically exhausted (we're at 8 GPUs). Can cloud team bump to 32 so we can scale bursts?

mike: What's the workload shape? ephemeral jobs or long-running?

chen: Mostly short jobs, 30–90m CUDA runs, fairly bursty around 02:00 UTC. Typical concurrency target is 6–10 jobs. Prefer low-cost preemptible/spot nodes but need an on-demand fallback for a couple of heavy evals.

sara: If it's bursty, I'd do autoscaler min=0 max=12 for the spot pool. Use T4 spot nodes for the common cases and 1–2 on-demand A100 nodes for heavy ones. Taint GPU nodes and force pods to use nodeSelector/tolerations.

priya: I'll open a quota ticket. Do we have a suggested machine/accelerator mix and rough cost numbers to include?

mike: For GCP: n1-standard-16 + nvidia-tesla-t4 is a good cheap combo. a2-highgpu-1 (A100) for heavy evals. Ballpark preemptible T4 ~ $0.3–0.4/hr, on-demand A100 ~ $2–3/hr depending on zone.

chen: Draft node-pool command (quick sketch):

```bash
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-batch-euw4 \
  --cluster=redwood-eu-prod \
  --num-nodes=0 \
  --min-nodes=0 \
  --max-nodes=12 \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 \
  --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 \
  --preemptible \
  --labels=pool=gpu-batch,accelerator=t4 \
  --node-taints=dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule
```

and a tiny on-demand pool: a2-highgpu-1, max 2 nodes, tainted for heavy jobs.

sara: Add cluster-autoscaler annotations so we ignore daemonsets, set scaleDownDelay=10m, and ensure the GPU driver daemonset is robust (retries, tolerations). Also we should enable the CA expander policy to prefer spot T4s first.

ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI — existing quota in europe-west4: 8 GPUs used / 8 quota for nvidia-tesla-t4. Upcoming request from priya.

priya: Ticket created: cloud-ops#642 — requested increase to 32 T4 GPUs in europe-west4. ETA 48h. cc @mike for cost approval.

mike: Approve increasing quota to 32 GPUs for the spot T4 pool. Add an alert if spot eviction rate > 5% over 30m so we can flip jobs to fallback pool.

chen: We'll add an image-based fallback to CPU pool for very short jobs (tolerations + nodeSelector + quick runtime check) so eviction doesn't kill progress. Running scheduled integration tests tomorrow at 02:00 UTC to validate scale-up/eviction behavior.

sara: Can we also spread the pool across multiple zones in europe-west4 to reduce correlated preemptions? And add a priority-based scale-up: prefer T4 spot nodes, then on-demand A100.

mike: Yep — multi-zone spread and separate node pools per instance type makes sense. Also check per-zone quotas; some zones may have less capacity.

chen: I'll push an IaC PR with the two pools + CA config + tuned drain/termination hooks and cost estimate. Will link when ready.

chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 — feedback welcome :thumbsup:
